FULL TEXT:
REVISED NOTICE
The interview of the eligible candidates who have applied for the Post Doc
Fellowship (PDF) for the session 2025-26 under Vivesvaraya Scheme
Electronic & IT, is scheduled to be conducted on
2nd April 2026 at 02:00 P.M in
the Office Chamber of Head, Department of Electronics & IT. All the eligible
candidates are advised to bring all the original qualification/degree certificates,
testimonials, publications etc. with them at the time of interview. No individual
call letters will be served in this regard.
(Prof. Z.A. Bhat)
DEAN
School of Applied Sciences & Technology
Copy to the:
1. Dean Research for information.
2. Head, Department of Electronics & IT3. Director, IT & SS, with the request to upload the notification on the official
website of University of Kashmir;
4. Notice Board; File
No: KU2026/DFAS/
Dated: 30-03-2026
OFFICE OF THE DEAN, SCHOOL OF

University of Kashmir, Srinagar
